name: LimX Oli
summary: Oli is a 165 cm, about 55 kg full-size humanoid with 31 DoF (excluding end effectors). It is sold in Lite, EDU and Super versions to AI researchers, developers and integrators, with open interfaces down to low-level joint control.

price.configuration: Lite version; EDU and Super cost more

highlights: Pre-orders opened in July 2025 at RMB 158,000.
SDK exposes robot state, sensor data, low-level joint control and task scheduling.
caveats: Speed, runtime and payload are not published in launch coverage.
Prices of EDU and Super versions are not public.
